classification: Token classification assigns labels to tokens in text, such as Named Entity Recognition and Part-of-Speech tagging.
Image classification assigns a label or class to an entire image based on its visual content.
Tabular classification classifies a table provided in image format into categories.
Audio classification assigns a label or class to a given audio signal for recognition tasks.
generation: Text generation produces new text, for example by filling in incomplete text or paraphrasing.
Text-to-image generation creates images from text prompts.
Text-to-video generation creates videos from text prompts.
Text-to-speech converts written text into natural sounding speech audio.
translation_summarization: Translation converts text from one language to another.
Summarization produces a shorter version of a document while preserving its important information.
question_answering: Question answering retrieves the answer to a question from a given text passage.
Visual question answering answers questions based on the content of an image.
Document question answering answers questions on document images using multimodal features.
detection_segmentation: Object detection identifies objects of certain defined classes and outputs bounding boxes and labels.
Image segmentation divides an image into segments where each pixel is mapped to an object.
Depth estimation predicts depth of the objects present in an image.
conversion_transformation: Image-to-image transforms a source image to match characteristics of a target image or domain.
Image-to-text outputs text from a given image, such as captioning or optical character recognition.
Audio-to-audio transforms input audio, such as speech enhancement and source separation.
Automatic speech recognition transcribes a given audio to text.
similarity_conversation: Sentence similarity determines how similar two texts are for information retrieval and clustering.
Conversational response modelling generates relevant, coherent and knowledgeable conversational text.
Image editing modifies an image to match a given text description by changing attributes.

text_only: Token classification processes text input to assign labels to individual tokens.
Translation takes text input and converts it to another language.
Summarization accepts text documents as input for condensation.
Conversational models take text prompts as input to generate responses.
Text generation models receive text input to produce new text output.
Sentence similarity compares two text inputs for semantic closeness.
Text-to-image models take text descriptions as input to generate images.
Text-to-video models take text descriptions as input to generate videos.
Text-to-speech models take written text as input to produce audio.
image_only: Image classification takes a single image as input for labeling.
Object detection receives an image as input to identify objects with bounding boxes.
Image-to-image takes a source image as input for transformation.
Image-to-text takes an image as input for captioning or OCR.
Image segmentation takes an image as input to produce pixel-level object maps.
Depth estimation takes an image as input to predict object depths.
Tabular classification takes a table image as input for classification.
audio_only: Automatic speech recognition takes audio as input to transcribe to text.
Audio-to-audio takes audio as input for speech enhancement or source separation.
Audio classification takes audio as input to assign a label or class.
multimodal: Question answering takes both a text question and a text passage as inputs.
Visual question answering takes both an image and a text question as inputs.
Document question answering takes both a document image and a text question as inputs.
Image editing takes both a text description and an image as inputs.

text_output: Token classification outputs text with labeled tokens.
Translation outputs translated text in the target language.
Summarization outputs a condensed text summary.
Question answering outputs a text answer extracted from the passage.
Conversational models output generated text responses.
Text generation outputs newly produced text.
Object detection outputs text labels and bounding box coordinates.
Image classification outputs text labels for the image class.
Image-to-text outputs text captions or recognized characters.
Visual question answering outputs a text answer about the image.
Document question answering outputs a text answer from the document.
Tabular classification outputs text class labels for the table.
Audio classification outputs text labels for the audio class.
Automatic speech recognition outputs transcribed text from audio.
image_output: Text-to-image outputs a generated image from the text prompt.
Image-to-image outputs a transformed version of the source image.
Image segmentation outputs a segmented image with pixel-level labels.
Depth estimation outputs a depth map image.
Image editing outputs a modified image matching the text description.
audio_output: Text-to-speech outputs natural sounding speech audio.
Audio-to-audio outputs enhanced or separated audio.
video_output: Text-to-video outputs a generated video from the text prompt.
embedding_output: Sentence similarity outputs a similarity score between two texts.

single_input: Token classification takes a single text and assigns token labels.
Translation takes a single text and converts its language.
Summarization takes a single document and produces a summary.
Conversational takes a single prompt and generates a response.
Text generation takes a single text and produces new text.
Image classification takes a single image and assigns a class.
Object detection takes a single image and detects objects.
Image-to-image takes a single image and transforms it.
Image-to-text takes a single image and produces a caption.
Image segmentation takes a single image and produces segments.
Depth estimation takes a single image and predicts depths.
Tabular classification takes a single table image and classifies it.
Text-to-image takes a single text and generates an image.
Text-to-video takes a single text and generates a video.
Text-to-speech takes a single text and generates speech.
Automatic speech recognition takes a single audio and transcribes it.
Audio-to-audio takes a single audio and transforms it.
Audio classification takes a single audio and assigns a class.
multi_input: Question answering requires both a question text and a context passage.
Sentence similarity requires two texts to compare for similarity.
Visual question answering requires both an image and a question.
Document question answering requires both a document image and a question.
Image editing requires both a text description and an image to modify.
pipeline_component: Image-to-text is commonly used as an intermediate step that feeds text to downstream tasks.
Automatic speech recognition often feeds transcribed text to downstream text processing tasks.
Object detection provides structured output that can feed into downstream visual reasoning.
Text generation is often used as a final step to produce human-readable output from structured data.
Image segmentation provides pixel-level labels that can be used by downstream image processing tasks.
